en-US.TUF_TAGLINE: Browse community levels, download them, then load them in the editor.
en-US.TUF_TIMEOUT: The request to TUF timed out.
en-US.TUF_OFFLINE: TUF could not be reached — you may be offline.
en-US.TUF_UNSAVED_BODY: The level open in the editor has changes you have not saved. Save them before loading this TUF level?
en-US.TUF_SAVE_FAILED: Your editor changes could not be saved.
en-US.TUF_EXIT_PLAY_FAILED: Could not leave play mode; stop the run yourself, then try again.
en-US.TUF_CHART_LOAD_REJECTED: The game could not load this level — it may require another mod.
en-US.TUF_LAUNCH_STATE_ERROR: Could not clear conflicting TUFHelper launch state.
en-US.TUF_LAUNCH_FAILED: Could not launch the TUF level: {0}
en-US.TUF_EDITOR_INIT_FAILED: Editor initialization was interrupted; check other mods.
en-US.TUF_EDITOR_CLOSED: Editor closed before the TUF level could load.
en-US.TUF_CHART_OPEN_FAILED: Could not open the downloaded chart: {0}
en-US.TUF_CHART_UNPLAYABLE: The downloaded chart could not be loaded or is not playable.
en-US.TUF_CHART_LOAD_TIMEOUT: The downloaded chart did not finish loading in the editor.
en-US.TUF_PACKS_TAGLINE: Browse level packs, open one, then load its levels.
en-US.TUF_PACK_NO_LEVELS: This pack has no playable levels.
en-US.DESC_TUF_OPEN_FOLDER: Opens the folder where downloaded TUF levels are saved.
en-US.DESC_TUF_LINK_HELPER: Saves downloaded levels into TUFHelperLite's Downloads folder (as tuf-<id>) so both mods share one level library. Inside the game folder, UMMMods is checked first, then Mods.
en-US.DESC_TUF_PREVIEWS: Show a blurred preview image behind each level in the browser, taken from its YouTube video. Turn off to skip the thumbnail downloads.
en-US.DESC_TUF_GRID_VIEW: Lay the level browser out as a grid of cards instead of one column of rows. The column count follows the window width.
en-US.DESC_TUF_INSTALLED: Show only the levels you have downloaded, newest first. Works offline.
en-US.TUF_INSTALLED_EMPTY: You have not downloaded any levels yet.
en-US.TUF_INSTALLED_NO_MATCH: No downloaded level matched your search.
en-US.TUF_INSTALLED_UNKNOWN: Downloaded before Quartz tracked level details.
en-US.DESC_TUF_DELETE: Delete this level from your library. Click it twice to confirm; the level can be downloaded again.
en-US.TUF_DELETE_FAILED: Could not delete this level; see the log.
en-US.TUF_NO_SPACE: Not enough space on the drive holding {0}. This level needs {1} and only {2} is free.
en-US.DESC_TUF_PICK_FOLDER: Choose an empty folder — on a roomier drive, for instance — to keep downloaded levels in. Levels you already have are moved there.
en-US.DESC_TUF_RESET_FOLDER: Moves levels back into Quartz's own folder inside the mod directory.
en-US.TUF_LIBRARY_LINK_OVERRIDE: The TUFHelperLite link above is on, so levels install there and this folder is not in use.
en-US.TUF_MOVE_PROGRESS: Moving levels to the new folder… {0}/{1}
en-US.TUF_MOVE_DONE: Moved {0} level(s) to the new folder.
en-US.TUF_MOVE_FAILED_COUNT: {0} level(s) could not be moved and stayed where they were: {1}
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_NOT_EMPTY: Pick an empty folder. Quartz manages everything inside the levels folder, so it will not take over one that already holds your files.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_VOLUME_ROOT: Pick a folder on the drive, not the drive itself.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_NESTED: That folder is inside Quartz's own levels folder.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_BUSY: Levels are still moving; wait for that to finish.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_LINKED: Turn off the TUFHelperLite link first — while it is on, that mod's folder is where levels install.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_SYMLINK: That folder is a link. Pick a real folder.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_UNUSABLE: That folder cannot be used for levels.
en-US.TUF_MAIN_LAUNCH_FAILED: Could not open the base-game level.
